author: stahlleiton
body:
#### PR description:

This PR adds the slimmed negative secondary vertex collection in the PbPb MiniAOD through the pp_on_AA era modifier for a future rereco. To ensure that the negative secondary vertex producer uses the same settings as the standard one, the modifiers are moved to the source file (e.g. inclusiveCandidateVertexFinder_cfi.py). Checks done using 10k PbPb minbias events show only an increase in event size of 3.5% and timing of 2.5%.

@mandrenguyen 

#### PR validation:

Tested with workflows 141.501,142.501,143.501,144.501,160.03,161.03,162.03,163.03

title: Add negative secondary vertex in PbPb MiniAOD
